TOOL_RESULT get_schema:
{"schema": "CREATE TABLE customers (customer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, email TEXT,
    region_code TEXT, signup_date TEXT, tier TEXT)
CREATE TABLE order_items (item_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER, product_id INTEGER,
    quantity INTEGER, unit_price_cents INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE orders (order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER, order_ts TEXT,
    status INTEGER, channel TEXT, coupon_code TEXT)
CREATE TABLE payments (payment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER, method TEXT,
    amount_twd INTEGER, paid_ts TEXT, payment_status TEXT)
CREATE TABLE products (product_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sku TEXT, product_name TEXT,
    category TEXT, list_price_twd INTEGER, is_active INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE refunds (refund_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER, item_id INTEGER,
    refund_amount_twd INTEGER, refund_ts TEXT, reason_code TEXT)
CREATE TABLE shipments (shipment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER, carrier TEXT,
    shipped_ts TEXT, delivered_ts TEXT)"}

{"thought": "依語意層定義，淨營收為有效訂單（status 1,2,3）商品金額扣除對應退款，期間以台北時間訂單成立時間歸屬，北部客戶為 region_code 'TW-N'。先確認單價欄位的單位與數量是否需相乘，並同時計算毛額與退款。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"queries": ["SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(unit_price_cents) AS min_p, MAX(unit_price_cents) AS max_p, AVG(unit_price_cents) AS avg_p, MIN(quantity) AS min_q, MAX(quantity) AS max_q FROM order_items", "SELECT SUM(oi.unit_price_cents) AS gross_no_qty, SUM(oi.unit_price_cents*oi.quantity) AS gross_with_qty FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE c.region_code='TW-N' AND o.status IN (1,2,3) AND strftime('%Y-%m',datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours'))='2025-11'", "SELECT SUM(r.refund_amount_twd) AS refunds, COUNT(*) AS n_refunds FROM refunds r JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=r.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE c.region_code='TW-N' AND o.status IN (1,2,3) AND strftime('%Y-%m',datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours'))='2025-11'", "SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY status"]}}
